_what_this_is: Which Valheim methods a Baseline mod actually Harmony-patches today, and what
event each patch produces. The event atlas joins this in so a seam can say
whether a quest can fire on it, instead of leaving the reader to guess.
Every row was read from the named source file, not remembered. When a patch
moves, update the source reference in the same commit -- a stale row here is
worse than a missing one, because the atlas presents it as fact.
